## Summary

Describe the user or business problem this change solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run audit`
- [ ] Manually checked the affected flow on desktop and mobile widths

## Domain and privacy review

- [ ] No customer data, credentials, or secrets were committed
- [ ] Garment configurations and specialized measurements remain explicit and intact
- [ ] Any new claim about security, synchronization, payments, or real-time behavior is backed by an actual implementation
- [ ] Accessibility labels, keyboard behavior, and contrast were considered

## Release notes

Call out migrations, environment variables, deployment changes, or known limitations.
